purpose: Prioritize article-led synthesis while preserving the complete file inventory, reusable meaning, generated references and all existing evidence. This routing is not new semantic review.

role_definitions.product_documentation: Authored product documentation, including overview/index frontmatter. Start synthesis here; preserve all product domains, qualifications and dependency references. A page is not a local obligation or proof of live behavior.
role_definitions.reusable_content: Shared authored passages contribute requirements, caveats and procedural meaning. Trace includes from pages and read each pinned passage once, retaining every consuming product/version context.
role_definitions.reference_data: Generated API, webhook, audit-event, permission and secret-pattern documentation plus reference tables, glossary and release notes. These are substantive reference inputs, not disposable website implementation. Preserve product and calendar-version distinctions.
role_definitions.applicability_data: Feature gates, variables, preview metadata and language/UI data can determine availability, displayed names and conditional meaning. Resolve alongside the consuming content; no implicit universalization.
role_definitions.interpretation_dependency: Source renderer, frontmatter, versions, product selection, links/redirects and reference-generation code or conventions. Trace when needed to interpret a page and its generated content; upstream code is read as data, not executed or adopted as policy.
role_definitions.illustration_dependency: Images, diagrams and example CSVs may carry procedural or architectural meaning. Retain and inspect when referenced; routing supplies no visual review or blanket decorative exclusion.
role_definitions.contract_fixture: Explicit synthetic fixtures, including mirrored content, schemas and images, support source tests. They are not independent platform guidance or observed target behavior.
role_definitions.contract_test: Source test assertions retain rendering/version boundary contracts; test presence does not establish GES or live-platform compliance.
role_definitions.contributor_context: Upstream contribution, authoring, repository operation and navigation context remains available with existing claims. It does not automatically impose the Docs toolchain or contribution practices on consumers.
role_definitions.site_infrastructure: Build/deployment/workflow, search/telemetry and site presentation support. Reuse existing dispositions and reopen files implicated by a concrete interpretation dependency; this role is not a semantic exclusion.
role_definitions.rights_metadata: Pinned license text is a rights input only; routing grants no clearance, adoption or distribution permission.

routing_basis: Pinned content, data and subject-folder conventions; all content index/frontmatter is retained.
Only explicit fixture paths are synthetic; all six generated-reference subjects retain their data.
Supporting roles retain every existing claim and receipt. Reopen on a concrete dependency; never infer reviewed status from routing.
